email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Skylar, saw the dbt Labs and Fivetran merger close and dbt Copilot move you into AI-assisted data ops.

A merger of that size usually means more accounts in play than the customer sales team can cover while the combined motion settles, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Skylar, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

Post-merger, expansion and cross-sell targets usually jump faster than the customer team can cover. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Skylar, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to other data platform teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Skylar, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and right after a merger the team is usually heads-down on integration.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a customer sales motion? I will tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
